basic_details.job_title: RITES Deputy General Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Rail India Technical and Economic Service (RITES), Gurgaon, Across India, has invited applications for 3 posts of Deputy General Manager (HR) under Advt No. RG/31-R1/25. The online application is open from 3 November 2026 to 2 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online payment. Last date to pay the fee: 2 December 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / PGDM / PGDHRM or equivalent in HR / Personnel Management / Industrial Relations / Labour Welfare / MHROD
qualification.details: Qualification: MBA/ PGDBA/ PGDBM/ PGDM/ PGDHRM or equivalent in HR/ Personnel Management/ Industrial Relations/ Labour Welfare / MHROD; MBA with specialization in HR/Personnel Management Experience: Minimum 11 years of post-qualification work experience in Human Resources Development Age limit: Maximum 41 years (as on 2 December 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST 5, OBC-NCL 3, J&K Domicile 5, PwBD 10 | Other conditions: | Only Indian Nationals of 18 years of age and above are eligible to apply.

exam_pattern.details: A minimum of 60% marks for UR/ EWS (50% for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/ PwBD against reserved posts) in interview will be required.

how_to_apply: Apply online in the registration format available in the Career Section of RITES website, http://www.rites.com.
Note down the generated Registration No. for future communication.
Upload all necessary documents under the Upload Document section.
Make online payment under the Make Payment section.
Download and print the final application form and keep a copy for selection.
important_instructions: Hard copies of documents are not to be sent through post/ courier.

content_sections.heading: Key Points
content_sections.text: Last date: 2 December 2026 Vacancies: 3 How to apply: Online Fee: General/OBC Candidates: Rs. 600 plus Taxes as applicable; EWS/ SC/ST/ PwBD Candidates: Rs. 300 plus Taxes as applicable Pay: INR 70,000-2,00,000 Age limit: Maximum 41 years (as on 2 December 2026) Place: India and abroad

content_sections.heading: RITES Deputy General Manager (HR) Recruitment 2026 - Overview

rows.rail_india_technical_and_economic_servic: MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / PGDM / PGDHRM or equivalent in HR / Personnel Management / Industrial Relations / Labour Welfare / MHROD

content_sections.heading: RITES Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. RG/31-R1/25 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download RITES notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: MBA/ PGDBA/ PGDBM/ PGDM/ PGDHRM or equivalent in HR/ Personnel Management/ Industrial Relations/ Labour Welfare / MHROD; MBA with specialization in HR/Personnel Management Experience: Minimum 11 years of post-qualification work experience in Human Resources Development Age limit: Maximum 41 years (as on 2 December 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST 5, OBC-NCL 3, J&K Domicile 5, PwBD 10 Other conditions: Only Indian Nationals of 18 years of age and above are eligible to apply.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment will be initially on probation for a period of one year.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online payment. Last date to pay the fee: 2 December 2026.

rows.event: Commencement of submission of online application and online payment of fees
Last date of submission of online application and online payment of fees

content_sections.heading: How Will RITES Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Document Scrutiny Interview Interview - 100% (Technical & Professional proficiency - 65 %; Personality Communication & Competency – 35%)

content_sections.heading: RITES Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: A minimum of 60% marks for UR/ EWS (50% for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/ PwBD against reserved posts) in interview will be required.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: High School certificate for proof of Date of Birth Certificates of Academic & Professional qualifications along with mark sheets Percentage Conversion Document EWS/ SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD Certificate Proof of Identity & Address PAN Card Proof of each period of experience claimed

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RITES Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online in the registration format available in the Career Section of RITES website, http://www.rites.com. Note down the generated Registration No. for future communication. Upload all necessary documents under the Upload Document section. Make online payment under the Make Payment section. Download and print the final application form and keep a copy for selection. Apply on or before 2 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Hard copies of documents are not to be sent through post/ courier.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 2 December 2026. Applications opened on 3 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies for Deputy General Manager (HR).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 2 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General/OBC Candidates: Rs. 600 plus Taxes as applicable. EWS/ SC/ST/ PwBD Candidates: Rs. 300 plus Taxes as applicable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 41 years (as on 2 December 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST 5, OBC-NCL 3, J&K Domicile 5, PwBD 10.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / PGDM / PGDHRM or equivalent in HR / Personnel Management / Industrial Relations / Labour Welfare / MHROD.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only Indian Nationals of 18 years of age and above are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Document Scrutiny. Interview. Interview - 100% (Technical & Professional proficiency - 65 %; Personality Communication & Competency – 35%).

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment will be initially on probation for a period of one year.
